reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that processes session event metrics and writes Markdown reports covering token usage, cache-hit rate, turn breakdowns, tool-call frequency, errors, duration, and optional cost estimates.

summaries.zh: 该插件监听会话事件并生成包含令牌用量、缓存命中率、按轮次统计、工具调用、错误记录和可选成本估算的 Markdown 报表。
summaries.en: This plugin listens to session events and generates Markdown reports with token usage, cache-hit rate, per-turn metrics, tool-call counts, errors, and optional cost estimates.

capabilities: 读取会话事件流中的 token、缓存、工具调用和错误记录
计算缓存命中率、耗时和可选成本估算
在本地写入 Markdown 会话报表
在进程退出时刷新报表数据
